newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA FUNDS USE 5-10 BROKERAGES - NAKYVA.
newsitem.headline: MERITA FUNDS USE 5-10 BROKERAGES - NAKYVA.

text.p: Finnish banking group Merita Oy's mutual fund company Merita Rahasto Oyis using five to 10 external brokerage houses in its operations, Merita Rahasto managing director Maarit Nakyva said on Wednesday.
"We do not exclusively use Merita Pankkiiriliike but also others which we have found to be good," Nakyva told a financial market briefing for journalists.
She declined to name which firms Merita was using since they are competitors to Merita Merita Pankkiiriliike.
"There are some five to 10 that we use, depending on the situation," she said.
In its investments in other Nordic countries, Merita prefers to use the services of local brokerage houses, she said.
When Merita uses five external brokers, two are foreign and when it uses 10, five are foreign, Nakyva said.
Asked what performance an equity fund should target, she said "there is good reason to expect in the long run a 10 percent annual return provided interest rates stay where they are at the moment."
The 22 brokerarages operating in Finland are:

Aros Securities Oy, AG Pankkiiriliike, Aktia Saastopankki Oy, Pankkiiriliike Arctos Securities Oy, Alfred Berg Pankiiriliike Oy, Pankkiiriliike Carnegie Suomi Oy, Pankkiiriliike Evli Oy, FIM Pankkiiriliike Oy, Pankkiiriliike L.Hiisi Oy, Interbank Osakepankki, Merita Pankkiiriliike Oy, Opstock Pankkiiriliike Oy, Postipankki Oy, Pankkiiriliike Protos Oy, Pankkiiriliike Oy Erik Selin Ab, Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken Helsinki branch, Pankkiiriliike Sofi Oy, Suomen FSB Oy Pankkiiriliike, Svenska Handelsbanken Helsinki branch, Oy United Bankers Pankkiiriliike, Williams de Broe Pankkiiriliike and, from October 1, Den Danske Bank Aktieselskab (remote member).
